remarks: Beautifully sited expanded cape on open level 1.5 acres renovated by Fox Hill Builders. This open-concept home features 4 bedrooms, 4 and 1/2 baths, and sun-filled, spacious rooms built for easy living and entertaining. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, a large center island, and granite countertops. The family room, open to the kitchen with New England colonial fireplace, opens to a bluestone patio overlooking the professionally landscaped lawn with mature plantings. Large living and dining rooms, both with wood-burning fireplaces, offer ample space for entertaining. A separate den could be used as a home office. The walk-out lower level has 2 large, finished areas and a full bath. This home has a very flexible floor plan with plenty of room for expansion or to live comfortably as is. A full-house generator completes the package of this meticulously maintained home. A popular central location close to schools, train, and downtown Darien. Lower level is included in the square footage.
